description: Generate a personalized transit horoscope, real-world strategic forecast, and exact astronomical time-windows for a user based on their natal placements and active planetary transits. Corresponds to /horoscope and /daily commands. Supports cadences: 'daily' (today's transits and hourly Horas), 'weekly' (7-day Monday–Sunday transit arc), 'monthly' (30-day sign ingresses & lunations), and 'yearly' (12-month Solar Return to Solar Return Varshaphala journey). MANDATORY PARAMETERS: The user's natal birth date ('birth_date', YYYY-MM-DD) and natal birth city ('birth_city') are strictly required. NEVER pass today's date into 'birth_date' — today's transit date is calculated automatically by the server based on location coordinates. If the user asks for a future or target date (e.g. next week or 2027), pass that date into 'target_date', NOT 'birth_date'. Optionally accepts 'current_city' if the user has relocated, 'cadence' ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly'), and 'user_prompt' containing the user's raw inquiry. For daily cadence, returns 'astronomical_time_windows' (exact topocentric sunrise/sunset, 24 planetary Horas, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit Muhurta, Brahma Muhurta) and 'panchang_timing' (exact Nakshatra and Tithi transitions). CRITICAL FOR AI: When suggesting times of day, you MUST quote the exact astronomical_time_windows provided. Never invent arbitrary hours.

birth_country.description: Natal country to disambiguate birth city
birth_country.title: Birth Country

birth_date.description: REQUIRED: User's natal birth date (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '1990-07-12'). Do NOT pass today's date here.
birth_date.title: Birth Date

birth_time.description: Natal birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format (default '12:00' if unknown)
birth_time.title: Birth Time

country.description: Country of birth or current location
country.title: Country

current_city.description: Current relocated city for topocentric horizon and local Horas (e.g. 'London')
current_city.title: Current City

include_image.description: Set to true to render and attach a dynamic chart wheel PNG image buffer in MCP outputs (default false)
include_image.title: Include Image

target_date.description: Target forecast date in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be today or future date)
target_date.title: Target Date

user_prompt.description: User's original inquiry for intent grounding and conversational context
user_prompt.title: User Prompt
